decisions.reason: The conferencing service remains complementary to our managed communications portfolio and still meets enterprise demand.
The metropolitan data centre connection network is core to our connectivity strategy and has demonstrated market adoption.
Optical spectrum connectivity is strategically important for high-bandwidth, software-defined infrastructure services.
The voice number ordering portal enhances digital self-service and operational efficiency for customers.
Carrier pre-selection telephony is a declining legacy service that no longer fits our strategic focus on software-defined and high-bandwidth connectivity.
Direct voice network connection still addresses essential enterprise voice needs, though its long-term prospects are limited.
